title: Publication markers, member-aware manifest and I4/I20 checks
summary: AzGuard-owned `#[Api]`/`#[Spi]`/`SpiKind` attributes mark every supported type of the type map, enums carry `@closed`/`@open`, the manifest generator publishes by attribute only and records members, overrides, constants, enum classes, generics and module roots; I4 (member-aware supported-symbol usage, report mode) and I20 (positional SPI calls) run in tests/Arch; the migration instruction section exists and the P2 harness prerequisites (D16 snapshot switch, D17 ownership fallback, two pre-existing PHPStan errors) are in place.
why: Release-gate condition 3 needs an attribute-classified surface and a generator that sees members and protected override points; every later P2 item marks its types and is measured by I4/I20. Location-based publication (97 types) and the zero-method facade make the 0.7.0 manifest unable to say what is supported (D4, D9). Hard risk: a marker pass that publishes a type the type map makes internal, or misses one, silently changes the frozen surface — the oracle comparison test prevents it.

include: New `Attributes\Api`, `Attributes\Spi`, `Attributes\SpiKind` exactly as knowledge/contracts#markers (type-map zone-new rows)

Attribute every existing type whose type-map row has marker Api/Spi(Implement)/Spi(Call) and action `keep` (and the existing Attributes such as `Attributes\CheckPermission`, `AsSource` per their rows); since '0.7'. Rows renamed/moved/created by later P2 items are marked by those items
`@closed`/`@open` on every attributed enum from the type-map enum column (D15)
`@internal` on constructors built by core and on public methods already documented internal; remove `@api`/`@spi` docblock tags (the attribute replaces them)

bin/api-manifest.php: publication = attribute only (delete API_LOCATION_PREFIXES/API_LOCATION_CLASSES and tag parsing); per type record attribute kind (api | spi-implement | spi-call) and since; public members plus protected members of non-final classes (override points) with full signatures and parameter names; constants with values; enum cases with `enum: closed|open`; PHPDoc `@param`/`@return`/`@var` generic and class-string strings of supported members; `@no-named-arguments` stance; `facade` methods derived from the entry class when `AzGuard\AzGuard` exists (P2.3 fills it); `roots` = the package's PSR-4 prefixes. Excluded: `@internal` members and types without attribute; a type under `\Internal\` with an attribute is an error

tests/Arch/ApiManifestTest.php: freshness (kept); internal namespaces carry no attribute and attributed types live outside `\Internal\`; every attributed type equals its oracle marker (marker column) and every oracle Api/Spi row with an existing FQCN is attributed; every attributed enum has exactly one tag equal to the oracle enum column; I4 member-aware usage — files owned (oracle) by scopes, audit, devtools, filament plus packages/core/stubs reference only attributed core types and non-@internal members, report mode against tests/Arch/Allowlists/i4.json
tests/Arch/SpiPositionalCallsTest.php (I20): no core-owned file calls a method declared by a `Spi(Implement)` type with named arguments; non-vacuity test with a synthetic violating file
tests/Arch/Ownership.php: a production file absent from oracle paths resolves by the FQCN it declares (D17); non-vacuity test; tests/Arch/invariants.json: I4 and I20 status build→checks listed

tests/Fixtures/Baseline070/Formats/FormatSnapshot.php and Persistence/Writer.php: the 0.7.0-tree guard is replaced by an explicit writer switch (`AZGUARD_BASELINE_WRITE=1`) usable on the current tree (D16); README updated to say the fixtures are regression guards

Fix the two pre-existing PHPStan errors: packages/core/src/Diagnostics/Checks/RoutesChecks.php:106 (argument.type) and packages/filament/src/Authorization/AuthorizesActions.php:91 (return.type) without behavior change

docs/upgrade.md: new first section `## From 0.7 to 1.0 (instructions for AI agents)` with the format of p2-execution#conventions rule 8 and the first lines (attributes replace @api/@spi tags; manifest format)
exclude: Renaming, moving or creating supported types other than the three attributes (later items)

reads.why: Rules every P2 item follows (reference wins, no shims, D17 placement, attributes, snapshots, migration lines)
Report-mode allowlist protocol and which entries this item removes
Exact validation commands and driver environment
Owners/roots, Internal placement rule, stable FQCNs, composition roots — where new files go
since values, generics are contract, positional SPI calls
Generator requirements, closed/open enums, named-argument policy, what becomes stable
Columns marker/enum/action the marking and the oracle test consume
I4 and I20 wording and status
Report-mode and non-vacuity patterns to reuse

rules: Marking is generated from the oracle by a throw-away script (not committed) and reviewed; the oracle-equality test is the proof.
A type whose oracle marker is `internal` gets no attribute even if it was published at 0.7.0 (it leaves the manifest now; its file moves in P3).
I4 allowlist entries carry {file, reference, kind (type|member), invariant: I4, owner_phase}; owner P2 entries are the work list of P2.2–P2.13 and must reach zero by P2.14.

The I20 rule must not depend on variable names; it resolves the called method name against the set of methods declared by Spi(Implement) types and reports named-argument calls in core-owned files; a reviewed false positive is fixed by calling positionally, never allowlisted.
guidance: Generator sketch: iterate PSR-4 roots of each package composer.json; `ReflectionClass::getAttributes(Api::class|Spi::class)`; members = `getMethods(IS_PUBLIC|IS_PROTECTED)` declared in the class, protected only when the class is not final, skip docblock `@internal`; PHPDoc capture = raw `@param`, `@return`, `@template` lines of the member docblock (normalised whitespace) so generic contracts are diffed. Keep apiType() `self` normalisation. For I4 member usage, resolve `$x->m()`/`X::m()` only where the class is known (static calls, `new X`, typed parameters/properties via a light token pass) — report unresolved receivers nothing; type-level usage is exact. Expect the 0.7.0 manifest to shrink by the location-published internal types and grow by protected members.
